Subject Line: A Nice Observation in Your Back yard

Dear [Neighbors Names Here],
I noticed today how beautifully colorful your yard is this Spring, the azalia, the forst trees all are blossoms, it’s so cheerful!
I thought to share and let your family appreciate the same as it’s a wonderful feeling.
Wear mask and be Safe.
Take good of Yourself. Have A Good One.

Sarvesha
